Who supplied the C used in this study?.answer: The C was supplied by Korea carbon black Co., Ltd..

What is the role of C in the experiment?.answer: The C serves as reducing agent.

What is the particle size of Fe?.answer: The Fe has a particle size of 5 µm.

What are the specific ball milling condi.answer: Ball milling conditions: speed 120 rpm, duration 24 h, using 6 mm diameter stainless steel balls (total weight 1,260 g), in a 307 cm³ container with hexane 100 cc medium.

What are the PECS equipment specificatio.answer: PECS equipment: spark plasma sintering machine (SPS 2040 Sumitomo Coal Mining Co. Ltd.), graphite die with 22.85 mm inside diameter, mechanical pressure 20 MPa, current range 1,100-1,200 A, voltage range 3.0-3.5 V.

What are the processing conditions for T.answer: For TiO2 route: heating rate 27 K/min, temperature range 973 K to 1473-1573 K.
For TiH2 route: heating rate 50 K/min, temperature range 973 K to 1373-1473 K.

What hydrogen capacity was achieved in t.answer: In the 1st cycle 673K: 0.12 wt% H for 50 min.
In the 3rd cycle 303K: 1.17 wt% H for 50 min. highest hydriding rate, activation completed.
In the 5th cycle 303K: 1.00 wt% H for 40 min.
In the 8th cycle 303K: 0.93 wt% H for 39 min.

What phases were detected by XRD at 1503.answer: XRD analysis at 1503K 10min TiO2 detected the following phases: Fe, C, TiO2, TiC, FeTi, Fe2Ti, FeTiO3, Ti.

What phases were detected by XRD at 1573.answer: XRD analysis at 1573K 3min TiO2 detected the following phases: TiC, FeTi, Fe2Ti, FeTiO3, Ti.

What phases were detected by XRD at 1373.answer: XRD analysis at 1373K 5min TiH2 detected the following phases: FeTi, Fe2Ti, Ti, Mn, C, FeMn3, Fe.

What phases were detected by XRD at 1473.answer: XRD analysis at 1473K 5min TiH2 detected the following phases: FeTi, Fe2Ti, Ti, C, Mn, FeMn3, Fe.

How was carbon content optimized in the.answer: Carbon content was optimized by reducing initial carbon from 15.048 wt% to 8.136 wt%, which resulted in remaining carbon after treatment decreasing from 14.24 wt% to 4.64 wt%, producing more FeTi and Fe2Ti phases.

What are the advantages of using TiH2 ov.answer: TiH2 advantages over TiO2: (1) No carbon addition required, avoiding carbon contamination; (2) Lower processing temperature (1373-1473K vs 1503-1573K); (3) Direct decomposition to Ti + H2; (4) Produces more FeTi and Fe2Ti phases; (5) Cleaner reaction pathway without carbide formation.

How does hydrogen storage performance ch.answer: Hydrogen storage performance: 3rd cycle shows highest capacity (1.17 wt% H), indicating completed activation. Performance gradually decreases with cycling: 5th cycle (1.00 wt% H), 8th cycle (0.93 wt% H at 39 min), showing typical capacity fade.

What equipment was used for FE SEM analy.answer: For FE SEM analysis: field-emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM, Philips Co., X130 SFEG).

What equipment was used for DLS analysis.answer: For DLS analysis: dynamic light scattering (DLS, Model: ELS-8000, Photal Otsuka Electronics, Japan).

What equipment was used for XRD analysis.answer: For XRD analysis: Rigaku D/max 2200 X-ray diffractometer.

What equipment was used for carbon analy.answer: For carbon analysis analysis: Carbon-sulfur determinator (Eltra CS-8000, Germany).

What is the particle size distribution a.answer: Particle size distribution: range 70 nm to 650 nm, average size 256 nm, dominant size range 190-230 nm, morphology: fine agglomerates of very fine particles.

Who are the authors and their affiliatio.answer: Authors: Seong-Hyeon Hong (KIMS); Myoung Youp Song (Chonbuk National University, corresponding author).
